name: Complete Password Reset
summary: A user follows a password-reset link, reaches the tokenized reset view, establishes a new password, and returns to password sign-in.
finalOutcome: The password credential is updated, the reset token is no longer reusable, and the anonymous user can sign in with the new password.

sourceReferences.note: The external email-link click resolves the tokenized route before the first UI-bound scenario begins.
